        - UITests

cat > Dummy/DummyApp.swift <<'EOF'
import SwiftUI

@main

        WindowGroup { Text("dummy") }

}

cat > UITests/PhoenixTests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest

final class PhoenixTests: XCTestCase {
    func testOpenProjectPhoenix() throws {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        let room = app.staticTexts["Project Phoenix"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
        print("PHX_COUNT \(app.staticTexts.matching(identifier: "Project Phoenix").count) label-matches")
        room.tap()
        sleep(3)
    }

    func testOpenRoomOptions() throws {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        sleep(2)
        let nav = app.navigationBars.firstMatch
        print("NAV \(nav.debugDescription)")
        let title = nav.staticTexts["Project Phoenix"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(title.waitForExistence(timeout: 15))
        title.tap()
        sleep(3)
    }
}
EOF
